subject: bafflement; adding a transformed parameter causes stan to fail, trying it again causes Rstudio to crash

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: bafflement; adding a transformed parameter causes stan to fail, trying it again causes Rstudio to crash
parts:
OK, I'm playing around with hierarchical models. First I fit the following, which works. Please note that two of the lines in the model are commented out.


hiertest_code <- '
data {
int n;
int K;
int J;
int group[n];
matrix[n,K] X;
int y[n];
}
parameters {
vector[K] b;
real eta[J];
real tau;
}
transformed parameters {
real a[J];
# real tau_finitepop;
for (j in 1:J)
a[j] <- tau*eta[j];
# tau_finitepop <- tau*sd(eta);
}
model {
for (i in 1:n)
y[i] ~ bernoulli (inv_logit(tau*eta[group[i]]+X[i]*b));
for (k in 1:K)
b[k] ~ cauchy (0, 2.5);
eta ~ normal (0,1);
}
'

library (arm)
n <- 1000
K <- 10
J <- 15
group <- rep (1:J, length=n)
X <- array (rnorm (n*K), c(n,K))
b_true <- (1:K)/10
tau_true <- 1
a_true <- rnorm (J, 0, tau_true)
probs <- invlogit (X%*%b_true + a_true[group])
y <- ifelse (runif(n)<probs, 1, 0)

library (rstan)
hiertest_fit <- stan(model_code = hiertest_code, data = c("n","K","J","group","X","y"),
iter = 10, n_chains = 4)



Then I uncomment the lines and re-run. This should (I think) have no effect on Stan because I'm only altering the transformed parameters, right???
Here's what happens:

TRANSLATING MODEL 'anon_model' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL 'anon_model' NOW.
SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'anon_model' NOW (CHAIN 1).
Error in sampler$call_sampler(args_list[[i]]) :
No acceptably small step size could be found. Perhaps the posterior is not continuous?


It happens every time I try it so I don't think it's just something with the random numbers.

Actually, I just tried it again and it caused Rstudio to crash!


I assume the problem is that I'm doing something dumb with the main model, but I don't know what it is….

Thx
A

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] bafflement; adding a transformed parameter causes stan to fail, trying it again causes Rstudio to crash
parts:
Very weird. That error message is saying that no matter how small you
make the step size you can't get a leapfrog update that doesn't create
a dramatic change in energy. Possibly some kind of subtle bug in sd()?
Are you allowed to call sd() on an array of doubles?

Matt
